about: This Secret addresses Jesus Christ directly. It brings together the remembrance of His Mother’s suffering, her intercession and that of her holy companions beneath the Cross, and the merits of His death in a petition for a reward among the blessed.

seg.tr: We offer You prayers and sacrifices, Lord Jesus Christ, humbly asking that we who recall in prayer the piercing of the most tender spirit of blessed Mary, Your Mother, may, through the abundant, most loving intercession of Mary and her holy companions beneath the Cross, receive a reward among the blessed by the merits of Your death. You live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: and of her holy companions beneath the Cross
through the multiplied, most loving intercession

ex.w030: “Intervéntu” has two possessors: “suo” (w022), Mary’s own, at the start of the phrase, and “suorúmque … Sanctórum consórtium,” her holy companions beneath the Cross. The phrase means “through the multiplied, most loving intercession of her and her holy companions beneath the Cross.”

nt.w027: These are Mary’s holy companions beneath the Cross. The prayer joins their intercession to hers, rather than speaking here of an abstract fellowship.
nt.w049: The nominative names Christ, who lives and reigns with the Father, as God. A vocative reading, addressing Him directly, is also possible.
